text:
jordyn: hey team — opened a small observability PR that adds a per-route latency heatmap and fixes a telemetry tag for model_id. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5421 can someone take a quick look? behind feature flag, aiming to canary tomorrow morning :eyes:

alex.k: looking now. quick skim — dashboards render, but I have one inline about an expensive query join.

samw: pinging @katie_s specifically for the trace sampling and span label bits, this touches the sampling hook we use for streaming traces.

katie_s: on it, will check span naming + resource attributes. do you have a smoke command?

jordyn: yep — run locally: `./devtools/run-obsv-smoke.sh --filter=latency_heatmap` then open `http://localhost:3000/dashboards/latency`. added unit tests under `pkg/telemetry/heatmap_test.go`.

ben-ops: quick ops note — retention/resolution might increase cost if we enable the highest bucket by default. please add a resolution cap or make it opt-in.

deploy-bot: Deploy cron: canary scheduled by @jordyn tomorrow 09:00 UTC if PR merged.

alex.k: left one inline comment about that join — could blow up on big namespaces. other than that, looks good to me.

jordyn: pushed a tiny query fix to reduce cardinality and respect the feature flag. thanks! plan is to merge at ~08:45 UTC tomorrow so the canary can start at 09:00.

samw: approved.

katie_s: approved — span names look consistent now.

ben-ops: :thumbsup: all good from infra side, watch retention costs post-canary.

jordyn: awesome, thanks everyone. will merge unless anyone objects before then — otherwise I’ll follow up with the rollout notes in #eng-releases.
